title: CBC: SmallShells MediumCannonExtension
description: Extension for SmallShells resourcepack, makes medium cannons from CBC: Modern Warfare smaller
body:
Resourcepack dedicated for people who wish for CBC:MW medium cannons to be smaller. Reduces the size of all medium cannons, perfect for tank building.

Most textures were adjusted to match new model size. Some textures were slightly changed artistically, original textures and models by CBC, CBC:MW and other featured addon mod developers.

Feedback and bug report appreciated.
